C08-M06-L07-F1.title: TLP 2.0: the five labels and how far each may travel
C08-M06-L07-F1.caption: Each Traffic Light Protocol 2.0 label, who a recipient may pass the information to, and when a source chooses it.
C08-M06-L07-F1.alt: Table with columns Label, Recipient may share with, and Source uses it when. TLP:RED (red row): named recipients only, no further disclosure; misuse would risk privacy, reputation or operations. TLP:AMBER+STRICT (orange row): own organisation only, need-to-know; recipients need it to act, but clients must not see it. TLP:AMBER (orange row): own organisation and its clients, need-to-know; recipients and their clients need it to protect themselves. TLP:GREEN (green row): peers and partners in the community, not via public channels; it is useful for awareness across the community. TLP:CLEAR (slate row): anyone, standard copyright applies; there is minimal foreseeable risk of misuse.
rows: Named recipients only; no further disclosure

C08-M06-L07-F1.note: Only the source sets the label; to share more widely than the label allows, a recipient must first get the source's permission.

C08-M06-L07-F2.title: Before release: the outbound sharing pipeline
C08-M06-L07-F2.caption: The six checks a SOC applies to any intelligence it sends out, with feedback flowing back into the next release.
C08-M06-L07-F2.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of six steps. 1 Purpose and audience (sighting, peer warning, mandatory report). 2 Inherited limits (source TLP, feed licence, NDA, client contract), shown in violet. 3 Strip and minimise (personal data, internal identifiers, victim identity), shown in orange. 4 Label and channel (outbound TLP; channel that can honour it). 5 Approve and record (owner, approver, what went to whom), shown in violet. 6 Share and follow up (sightings, corrections, expiry), shown in dark. A dashed loop arrow labelled feedback and corrections returns from step 6 to step 2.

C08-M06-L07-F2.note: The outbound label can never be less restrictive than the most restrictive label on anything the release contains, unless the source agrees.
